workflows.name: accept-web-search-citation-followup
workflows.summary: Follow-up of the acceptance review: run the missing code-review dimension, verify the remaining unverified finding, then completeness critic and gap checks (no public network)

workflows.name: accept-web-search-citation-gap2
workflows.summary: Retry the failed GAP-2 test-sensitivity check of the acceptance review and run the final completeness critic (no public network)

workflows.name: accept-web-search-citation-plan
workflows.summary: Independent acceptance review of the executed 2026-10-20 web search/citation plan: 10 dimension reviewers, adversarial verification, completeness critic

stages: S02 讀計劃檔、build-log、git 歷史
S03 協調者親自先驗（重編 dist、Node 測試、pytest）
S04 撰寫並啟動 workflow #1（主驗收）
S05 等待中讀 phase 檔、回報進度
S06 workflow #1 結束 → 撞 session limit #1
S08 讀第一輪結果、親自重現巢狀表格缺陷
S09 workflow 結束 → 撞 session limit #2
S10 續跑 #2，檢查後中止，改寫補充 workflow #2
S11 補充 workflow 組裝失敗 → 修腳本、resume、親自驗 owner flag
S12 workflow 結束 → 撞 session limit #3
S13 Try again：從 journal 重建結果、啟動 GAP-2 workflow #3
S14 統整結果、寫 memory、最終驗收報告
